headline: Audi to Build Manufacturing Plant in Georgia to Counter Tariff Drag
summary: Volkswagen division Audi plans to build a vehicle factory in Georgia, according to former President Trump. The automaker has faced earnings pressure from US tariffs as it currently imports all vehicles from Europe and Mexico.
why: Audi is a premium automotive brand owned by Volkswagen AG; localizing assembly reduces foreign exchange risks and import tariff burdens in its core North American market.
